WITH monthly_activity AS (
    SELECT 
        strftime('%Y-%m', s.shipment_date) AS month,
        COUNT(*) AS record_count
    FROM Invoices i
    INNER JOIN Shipments s ON i.invoice_number = s.invoice_number
    WHERE s.shipment_date >= '2018-01-01' AND s.shipment_date <= '2018-06-30'
    GROUP BY strftime('%Y-%m', s.shipment_date)
)
SELECT 
    month,
    record_count,
    SUM(record_count) OVER (ORDER BY month ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) AS running_total,
    RANK() OVER (ORDER BY record_count DESC) AS activity_rank
FROM monthly_activity
